# Libraries
```{r}
library(pafr, quietly = TRUE)
library(patchwork)
```


# Read Data

## Read PAFs

```{r}
pafdirW <- "../../alignments/W/"
pafdirZA <- "../../alignments/ZA/"

alnWfiles <- dir(pafdirW)
alnZAfiles <- dir(pafdirZA)
```

Clean up labels

```{r}
alnLabels <- gsub(pattern = "(\\S+?)_.*_vs_(\\S+?)_.*", 
                  replacement = "\\1_vs_\\2",
                  x = alnWfiles)
qryLabels <- gsub(pattern = "(\\S+?)_.*_vs_(\\S+?)_.*", 
                  replacement = "\\1",
                  x = alnWfiles)

names(alnWfiles) <- qryLabels
names(alnZAfiles) <- qryLabels

```


Import pafs

```{r}
pafsW <- lapply(alnWfiles, function(x) {read_paf(file_name = paste0(pafdirW,x)) })
pafsZA <- lapply(alnZAfiles, function(x) {read_paf(file_name = paste0(pafdirZA,x)) })
```


## Chrom order reference
Need this for specifying order of chroms in `pafr` dotplots.
```{r}
chroms <- readLines("../../config/autosomes_Z.txt")
```

# Plot

## Plot W

```{r}
dotplotW <- list()
for (i in seq_along(pafsW)) {
  dotplotW[[i]] <- dotplot(ali = pafsW[[i]], 
                           line_size = 0.5,
                           ylab = "p50T",
                           xlab = qryLabels[i],
                           alignment_colour = "blue3") + 
    theme_classic()
}
```

## Plot Z & Autosomes

```{r,fig.height=15, fig.width=10}
dotplotW[[1]] + dotplotW[[2]] + dotplotW[[3]] + dotplotW[[4]] + dotplotW[[5]] +
   plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
   plot_annotation(title = "W chromosome")
  
```


```{r}
dotplotZA <- list()
for (i in seq_along(pafsZA)) {
  dotplotZA[[i]] <- dotplot(ali = pafsZA[[i]], 
                           line_size = 0.5,
                           ylab = "p50T",
                           order_by = "provided", 
                           ordering = list(chroms,chroms),
                           xlab = qryLabels[i],
                           alignment_colour = "green4") + 
    theme_classic()
}
```



```{r, fig.height=15, fig.width=10}
dotplotZA[[1]] + dotplotZA[[2]] + dotplotZA[[3]] + dotplotZA[[4]] + dotplotZA[[5]] +
   plot_layout(ncol = 2, axes = "collect") +
   plot_annotation(title = "Z & Autosomes")
  
```
